findings.description: The bucket has no ACL set to private and no public access block; the inline comment confirms it is intended to be public, exposing all objects (including the uploaded customer master file) to anonymous readers.
No server_side_encryption_configuration block is defined, so sensitive customer data is stored unencrypted at rest.
No logging block is configured, so access to this publicly reachable bucket is not auditable.
Versioning is disabled, so object overwrite or deletion (including malicious tampering or ransomware) is irreversible.
A file named customer-master.xlsx containing apparent customer PII is uploaded into aws_s3_bucket.data, which is public and unencrypted, exposing sensitive data to the internet.
No server_side_encryption_configuration is set on a bucket holding financial data, leaving it unencrypted at rest.
No logging block is configured, so access to financial data cannot be audited or investigated after a compromise.
Versioning is disabled, so deletion or overwrite of financial records cannot be recovered or detected.
No aws_s3_bucket_public_access_block is associated, so a future ACL or bucket policy change could expose the bucket publicly without guardrails.
No server_side_encryption_configuration block is defined, so stored objects are not encrypted at rest with SSE-KMS or SSE-S3.
No logging block is configured, leaving no audit trail of object-level access to this bucket.
No public access block guardrail is applied to prevent future public ACLs or bucket policies.
No server_side_encryption_configuration block is defined, so data science datasets are stored unencrypted at rest.
No public access block guardrail is applied to prevent future public ACLs or bucket policies.
The central log bucket itself has no access logging configured, so tampering with or reading of audit logs is not recorded.
No aws_s3_bucket_public_access_block protects the audit log bucket from being made public by a later ACL or policy change.
force_destroy = true on the audit log bucket allows all log objects to be destroyed by a terraform apply, undermining log retention and integrity for incident investigation.
